01 — The Opportunity

A rare, shovel-ready infill development in West Broward

Cypress of Sunrise is a fully-designed, six-residence luxury townhome community on a 0.832-acre corner parcel in the heart of Sunrise, Florida. It is delivered with a complete, multi-discipline construction-document set, a fully-approved building permit package, and a fixed-price, transferable general-contractor agreement — so the next owner bypasses years of design, entitlement and pre-construction and can begin vertical construction immediately.

The land sits in Flood Zone X — no mandatory flood insurance — and is already platted as its own parcel of record. This is not raw land: it is a packaged, permit-ready development in one of West Broward's most established, owner-occupied residential corridors, a submarket with no new townhome supply since 2022.

Fully Permitted

Architectural, structural, civil, MEP and landscape drawings complete. Building permits BA-010019 / 020 / 021-2025 approved.

Construction Priced

Fixed-price general-contractor agreement in place and transferable to the buyer — construction pricing risk already resolved.

Two Business Plans

Build-to-sell or build-to-rent six residences. The buyer underwrites the strategy that fits its goals.

Clean, Buildable Site

Corner lot, platted, vacant, Flood Zone X, new sidewalks and street frontage on three sides, utilities at the site.

Renderings by MUVE Architecture. Drone photography 2026. Illustrative; final product per approved plan set.

03 — The Development

Six luxury townhomes, designed to sell and to lease

The approved design delivers six two-story townhome residences arranged as three duplex buildings in a warm Mediterranean-modern language — stone-veneer bases, smooth stucco, barrel-tile accents, balconies and private garages. Three bedrooms, two-and-a-half baths, a private driveway and an additional parking space per residence, with four visitor spaces shared across the community.

Specified Finishes

The GC agreement already carries kitchen cabinetry, closets, appliance package, porcelain floors, impact windows and doors, 3-ton high-efficiency HVAC and a low-voltage package per unit.

Boutique Scale

Duplex configuration preserves a single-family feel with no shared corridors, no elevator and no condominium-style common areas.

No new supplyZero new townhomes closed in Sunrise since 2022. Inventory sits at 4.8 months of supply, against 5.9 in Broward and 7.8 in Miami-Dade.
Rents support pricesA Sunrise townhome is worth 11.9 years of rent; Broward 12.6, Miami-Dade 12.8, Doral 14.0. Rents grew 1.3% a year while Miami-Dade rents fell.
Land led the wayResidential lot values in west-central Broward have more than tripled since 2017 — about 13% a year. New-construction land is the scarce input in this corridor.
Catch-up still aheadSunrise closed six points of its discount to Broward since 2022 and outpaced both counties — from a lower base, with the lowest inventory of the three.

06 — The Location

Sunrise, Florida

One of Broward County's largest and most economically diverse cities, Sunrise pairs an established residential base with a powerhouse commercial core — anchored by Sawgrass Mills, the Amerant Bank Arena and South Florida's largest corporate office park. The result is durable, year-round housing demand from both owner-occupants and renters.
